title: Holiday party venue
script:
Man: Have we decided where to hold the holiday party in December?
Woman: Not yet. The rooftop restaurant has a great view, but it can only seat about sixty people.
Man: We have eighty-five people on the guest list, so that won't work.
Woman: Right. The hotel ballroom holds up to a hundred, and it has a stage for the awards ceremony.
Man: That sounds good. Is it much more expensive?
Woman: A little. But they're offering a free dessert buffet if we book this week.
Man: Then let's call them today.
translation:
男性:12月の休日パーティーの会場はもう決まった?
女性:まだなの。屋上のレストランは眺めがすばらしいけど、座れるのは60人くらいなの。
男性:招待客は85人だから、それでは無理だね。
女性:そうね。ホテルの宴会場なら100人まで入るし、表彰式用のステージもあるわ。
男性:それはいいね。ずっと高いのかな?
女性:少しね。でも今週中に予約すれば、デザートのビュッフェを無料にしてくれるって。
男性:じゃあ、今日電話しよう。

questions.question: What are the speakers planning?
choices: A business trip
A product demonstration
A holiday party
A charity auction
questions.explanation: 12月の休日パーティーの会場を決めている。

questions.question: Why will the rooftop restaurant not work?
choices: It is too far from the office.
It cannot seat all the guests.
It does not have a stage.
It is closed in December.
questions.explanation: 屋上のレストランは約60人しか座れないが、招待客は85人いる。

questions.question: What does the man mean when he says, "Then let's call them today"?
choices: He wants to ask for a different date.
He will tell the guests about the change.
He wants to reserve the ballroom quickly.
He doubts the hotel will answer the phone.
questions.explanation: 今週中に予約するとデザートビュッフェが無料になるので、今日すぐ電話して押さえようという意味。

title: Company picnic plans
script:
Woman: Tom, the forecast for Saturday now says there's a seventy percent chance of rain. Our company picnic is in trouble.
Man: That's a shame. Most of the food is already bought, though.
Woman: I checked the park's indoor pavilion. It's free on Sunday, so we could move the picnic there.
Man: But most of our people can't come on Sunday. They have a training session that day.
Woman: Then let's cancel the picnic and send everyone a lunch voucher instead.
Man: Good. I'll tell the caterer tonight.
translation:
女性:トム、土曜日の予報が雨の確率70%に上がったわ。社内ピクニックが危ないの。
男性:それは残念だね。でも食材はもうほとんど買ってあるんだ。
女性:公園の屋内施設を調べたの。日曜日は空いているから、ピクニックをそこに移せるわ。
男性:でも社員の大半は日曜日に来られないんだ。その日は研修があるから。
女性:じゃあピクニックは中止にして、かわりに全員にランチ券を配りましょう。
男性:そうしよう。今夜ケータリング会社に伝えておくよ。

questions.question: Why does the woman want to change the plans?
choices: The food supplier has gone out of business.
The park is closed for repairs.
Some staff members have quit.
The weather forecast predicts rain on Saturday.
questions.explanation: 土曜日の雨の確率が70%に上がったため、ピクニックが危なくなった。

questions.question: What does the man mean when he says, "Most of the food is already bought, though"?
choices: He wants to order more food for Sunday.
He thinks the caterer should be replaced.
He is worried about the money already spent on food.
He is pleased that the weather will be good.
questions.explanation: 食材はもう買ってあり、無駄になるお金を気にしている。

questions.question: Why will the picnic not be moved to Sunday?
choices: Many employees cannot come that day.
The pavilion is already booked.
The food has gone bad.
The weather forecast for Sunday is worse.
questions.explanation: 屋内施設は日曜日に空いているが、社員の大半がその日は研修のため来られない。

title: Graphic: Shuttle bus schedule
graphic:
Shuttle Bus Schedule — Hall C to Central Station
------------------------------------------------
 Bus   Departs   Arrives   Seats left
 S1    5:00 pm   5:20 pm   0
 S2    5:30 pm   5:50 pm   2
 S3    6:00 pm   6:20 pm   9
 S4    6:30 pm   6:50 pm   14
script:
Woman: Ahmed, Lily, we need to be at Central Station by six thirty to meet the head office team. Which shuttle should we take?
Man: The five-thirty bus gets us there in time, but it has only two seats left, and there are three of us.
Woman 2: Then the six o'clock one is the best choice. It has plenty of seats and arrives at twenty past six.
Man: Good. I'll reserve three seats on it now.
Woman: Thanks, both of you. I'll let the head office know we're on our way.
translation:
女性:アーメド、リリー、6時30分までにセントラル駅で本社チームと合流しないといけないの。どのシャトルに乗るのがいいかしら。
男性:5時30分のバスなら間に合うけど、残りの座席が2つしかないんだ。僕たちは3人だよね。
女性2:じゃあ6時のバスがいちばんいいわね。座席はたっぷり空いているし、6時20分に着くから。
男性:そうしよう。今すぐその便の座席を3つ予約するよ。
女性:ありがとう、2人とも。本社には出発することを伝えておくわ。

questions.question: Where do the speakers need to be by six thirty?
choices: At Central Station
At Hall C
At the head office
At a hotel near the fair
questions.explanation: セントラル駅で本社チームと6時30分までに合流する必要がある。

questions.question: Look at the graphic. Which shuttle will the speakers take?
choices: Bus S3, departing at 6:00 pm
Bus S2, departing at 5:30 pm
Bus S4, departing at 6:30 pm
Bus S1, departing at 5:00 pm
questions.explanation: 6時30分までに着く必要があり、S2は座席が2つしかなく3人には足りない。S3は6時20分着で9席空いている。S4は6時50分着で間に合わない。S1は満席。

questions.question: What does the man mean when he says, "there are three of us"?
choices: They should invite a third colleague to the meeting.
They need a larger shuttle for their luggage.
They will have to share a taxi with another group.
The bus must have enough seats for all of them.
questions.explanation: 残り2席では3人分が足りないと言っており、全員が座れる便が必要だという意味。

title: Duplicate invoice charge
script:
Man: Hi, Diana. This is Kenji from Harbor Foods. I'm calling about invoice 4417. We were charged twice for the same shipment of cardboard boxes.
Woman: I'm sorry about that. I can see both charges in our system too.
Man: Could you cancel the second one? Our accounts team can't process the payment until it's corrected.
Woman: I'd like to, but the credit note has to go through our finance department. I'll email them today.
Man: How long will that take?
Woman: Usually about three business days. Once you have the note, your accounts team can subtract it from next month's payment.
Man: Okay. Please let me know as soon as it's approved.
translation:
男性:もしもし、ダイアナ。こちらはハーバー・フーズのケンジです。請求書4417番の件で電話しています。同じダンボール箱の出荷に対して、2回請求されているんです。
女性:それは申し訳ありません。当社のシステムでも両方の請求が確認できます。
男性:2回目の請求を取り消してもらえますか。修正されるまで、当社の経理チームは支払い処理ができないんです。
女性:そうしたいのですが、貸方票は当社の経理部を通す必要があるんです。今日中に経理部にメールしておきます。
男性:どのくらいかかりますか。
女性:通常は営業日で3日ほどです。貸方票を受け取れば、経理チームは来月の支払いから差し引けます。
男性:わかりました。承認されたらすぐに知らせてください。

questions.question: What is the man calling about?
choices: A late delivery of boxes
A change in packaging prices
A duplicate charge on an invoice
A missing signature on a contract
questions.explanation: 同じダンボール箱の出荷に対して2回請求されている。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "I'd like to, but the credit note has to go through our finance department"?
choices: She is unwilling to help the man.
She has already sent the credit note.
She wants the man to call the finance department.
She cannot cancel the charge herself.
questions.explanation: 請求を取り消したいが、貸方票は社内の経理部を通す必要があるので、自分では取り消せないという意味。

questions.question: What will the woman most likely do today?
choices: Send the man a new invoice
Email the finance department
Visit the customer's office
Cancel the shipment of boxes
questions.explanation: 今日中に経理部にメールすると言っている。

title: Graphic: Electricity use by building
graphic:
Electricity Use by Building — March
---------------------------------------
 Building   Usage (kWh)   Change from Feb
 North      5,000         +12%
 South      3,100         -4%
 East       4,200         +11%
 West       1,900         -20%
script:
Woman: Kevin, the March electricity report is in. Overall usage went up, which surprised me.
Man: Most of the increase came from the North building. Its air conditioners ran all month during the heat wave.
Woman: Normally I'd want it inspected again, but the maintenance crew already checked those units last week.
Man: Then let's send someone to the building with the second-biggest increase.
Woman: Good. And tell them to check the lighting while they're there.
translation:
女性:ケビン、3月の電気使用量の報告が届いたわ。全体では使用量が増えていて、驚いたの。
男性:増えた分の大半はノース棟だよ。熱波の間、1か月ずっと空調が動いていたんだ。
女性:本当なら再点検したいところだけど、整備チームが先週、そのユニットを確認したばかりなのよね。
男性:じゃあ、増加率が2番目に大きい棟に人を送ろう。
女性:そうね。そこでは照明も見てもらうよう伝えてね。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "Overall usage went up, which surprised me"?
choices: She was pleased that electricity costs had dropped.
She had expected electricity use to decrease in March.
She wants the building managers to reduce their staff.
She thinks the heat wave lasted longer than usual.
questions.explanation: 全体の使用量が増えたことに驚いたと言っている。3月は減ると予想していたという意味。

questions.question: Why will the North building not be inspected?
choices: Its electricity use decreased in March.
The building is closed for renovation.
Its air conditioners were already checked last week.
The maintenance crew is on vacation.
questions.explanation: 整備チームが先週、北棟の空調機器を点検済みだと言っている。

questions.question: Look at the graphic. Which building will be inspected?
choices: South
East
West
North
questions.explanation: 北棟は増加率12%で最大だが点検済み。次に増加率が大きい東棟(11%)を点検することになる。

title: Three speakers: Logistics contract renewal
script:
Woman: Before we sign the logistics contract, legal flagged a clause that renews it automatically unless we give ninety days' written notice.
Man: That's standard, isn't it? Our current contract has the same arrangement.
Man 2: Not quite. The current one requires only thirty days' notice, and the new draft also stipulates a penalty equal to three months' fees if we terminate early.
Woman: So if we're not careful, we could be locked in for another year without realizing it.
Man: Then we should ask them to waive the penalty, or at least shorten the notice period to sixty days.
Man 2: They may refuse, but it's worth asking. Our order volume has grown since we first negotiated the contract, so we have some leverage.
Woman: I agree. Let's revise our position before the Monday meeting.
translation:
女性:ロジスティクス契約に署名する前に、法務部が条項を1つ指摘したの。90日前に書面で通知しない限り、自動的に更新されるというものよ。
男性:それは普通のことでしょう?今の契約も同じ取り決めだよね。
男性2:少し違うんです。今の契約は30日前の通知で済みますが、新しい案では、途中で解約した場合に3か月分の料金に相当する違約金も定められています。
女性:つまり、注意しないと、気づかないうちにさらに1年縛られてしまうかもしれないということね。
男性:それなら違約金を免除してもらうか、少なくとも通知期間を60日に短縮するよう頼もう。
男性2:断られるかもしれませんが、聞いてみる価値はあります。契約を最初に交渉してから取引量が増えているので、ある程度の交渉力はあるんです。
女性:同感よ。月曜の会議の前に、こちらの立場を見直しましょう。

questions.question: What concern does the woman raise about the new contract?
choices: It could renew automatically before the company notices.
Its prices are higher than those in the current contract.
It excludes two of the company's warehouses.
It requires payment in advance for the full year.
questions.explanation: 90日前の通知がないと自動更新され、気づかないうちにさらに1年縛られる恐れがあると懸念している。

questions.question: Why does the second man believe the company has some leverage?
choices: The vendor has already agreed to waive the penalty.
The legal team has rejected the clause.
Its order volume has grown since the contract was first negotiated.
The current contract expires next week.
questions.explanation: 契約を交渉してから取引量が増えており、交渉の余地があると言っている。

questions.question: What does the first man imply when he says, "That's standard, isn't it?"
choices: He wants the penalty to be increased.
He assumed the clause was ordinary.
He is ready to cancel the contract.
He thinks the legal team should rewrite the draft.
questions.explanation: 現行契約と同じ取り決めだと思い込んでいたが、後で違うと分かった。

title: Graphic: Marketing budget, third quarter
graphic:
Marketing Budget — Third Quarter (in $ thousands)
----------------------------------------------
 Category       Budget   Spent   Left
 Advertising    120      134     -14
 Events          60       41      19
 Research        45       45       0
 Trade shows     80       72       8
script:
Man: I've finished reviewing the third-quarter marketing numbers. Advertising is over budget again.
Woman: By how much? I thought the overrun would be smaller than that.
Man: About fourteen thousand dollars. The online campaign ran two weeks longer than planned.
Woman: We can't just absorb that. Can we move money from another line?
Man: Events has nineteen thousand left, so that looks like the easiest option. The Vancouver conference was canceled.
Woman: I'd rather not touch trade shows. They generate most of our sales leads.
Man: Agreed. Research is exactly on budget, so it can't help either.
Woman: Then let's cover the advertising overspend from events and send the revised figures to finance today.
translation:
男性:第3四半期のマーケティング費用の確認が終わったよ。広告費がまた予算を超えている。
女性:どのくらい?超過はもっと少ないと思っていたわ。
男性:約1万4千ドルだ。オンライン広告のキャンペーンが予定より2週間長く続いたんだ。
女性:そのまま吸収するわけにはいかないわ。ほかの項目からお金を移せないかしら。
男性:イベントに1万9千ドル残っているから、それが一番簡単そうだ。バンクーバーの会議は中止になったからね。
女性:展示会の予算には手をつけたくないの。あそこが営業のリードの大半を生んでいるから。
男性:同感だ。研究費はちょうど予算通りだから、そこからも出せないね。
女性:じゃあ、広告費の超過はイベントから補いましょう。修正した数字は今日中に財務部に送って。

questions.question: What problem does the man report?
choices: Advertising spending went over its budget.
An online campaign was canceled.
The research budget was cut too much.
Trade show costs were higher than expected.
questions.explanation: 広告費が予算を約1万4千ドル超えた。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "I'd rather not touch trade shows"?
choices: The trade show budget has already been spent.
The trade show budget should be moved to advertising.
Trade shows are the easiest way to cover the overspend.
Trade shows are the main source of the company's sales leads, so their budget should be kept.
questions.explanation: 展示会は営業のリードの大半を生んでいるため、その予算は残したいという意味。

questions.question: Look at the graphic. Which category will cover the advertising overspend?
choices: Events
Trade shows
Research
Advertising
questions.explanation: 広告の超過は約1万4千ドルで、残りが1万9千ドルあるイベントから移す。展示会は残りが8千ドルで足りず、研究費は予算ぴったりで余りがない。

title: Three speakers: Patent filing deadline
script:
Woman: Our patent application has to be filed by Tuesday, or we'll lose the priority date. Where do we stand?
Man: The engineers have finished the drawings, but the claims section still needs a legal review.
Man 2: I can go through the claims tonight, but our patent attorney is away until Wednesday, and only she can approve the final version.
Woman: Is there nobody else who can sign off?
Man 2: Not under our company policy. We could file a provisional application now, though. It secures the date, and the detailed claims can be added within a year.
Man: That would protect us, but it adds about twenty thousand dollars in fees.
Woman: That's an option, but I'd need the board's approval before we pay the extra fees.
translation:
女性:特許出願は火曜日までに提出しないといけないの。さもないと優先日を失ってしまうわ。今どこまで進んでいるの?
男性:技術者が図面は仕上げたんだけど、請求項の部分はまだ法務のチェックが必要なんだ。
男性2:請求項なら今夜見直せるんですが、特許担当の弁護士が水曜日まで不在で、最終版を承認できるのは彼女だけなんです。
女性:ほかに承認できる人はいないの?
男性2:社内規定では無理です。ただ、今のうちに仮出願をすることもできます。それで日付は確保でき、詳細な請求項は1年以内に追加できるんです。
男性:それで守れるけど、手数料が2万ドルほど余計にかかるね。
女性:それも選択肢ね。でも、その追加費用を払う前に取締役会の承認が必要だわ。

questions.question: What is the main problem the group is facing?
choices: The engineers have not finished the drawings.
The attorney who must approve the filing is unavailable until after the deadline.
The board has rejected the patent idea.
The government has raised the filing fee.
questions.explanation: 締め切りの火曜日までに最終承認できる弁護士が、水曜日まで不在である。

questions.question: What does the second man suggest?
choices: Hiring an outside law firm to sign the application
Asking the board to extend the deadline
Reviewing the drawings again with the engineers
Filing a provisional application to secure the date
questions.explanation: 仮出願をすれば日付を確保でき、詳細な請求項は1年以内に追加できると提案している。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "That's an option"?
choices: She wants to reject the proposal.
She is sure the board will agree.
She thinks the cost is not important.
She will consider the proposal but needs approval first.
questions.explanation: 提案は選択肢として検討できるが、追加費用を払う前に取締役会の承認が必要だと言っている。
